## 中文

- **Android 对话归档**：可从会话标题栏归档，也可在对话列表中滑动归档；已归档内容可从“对话”页面再次找到。
- **Plugin 设置页**：适配 DSH 原生详情页布局，设置内容与宿主界面保持一致。
- **流式传输保护**：超大的 Harness Remote 流帧会单独结束为失败，不会拖断整个加密连接。

Plugin 与 Android 均为 **0.5.5**（Android `versionCode 43`）。iOS 客户端仍在内测招募中，欢迎通过 [iOS issue #20](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/issues/20) 报名和反馈。

## English

- **Android conversation archiving:** archive from the chat header or swipe a conversation row; archived conversations remain available from the Conversations screen.
- **Plugin settings page:** matches the native DSH detail page layout so Remote settings fit the host interface.
- **Stream protection:** an oversized Harness Remote stream frame now fails on its own without taking down the encrypted peer connection.

Upgrade both Plugin and Android to **0.5.5** (Android `versionCode 43`). The iOS client is currently collecting beta users and feedback through [iOS issue #20](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote/issues/20).
